global_vibe: Himalayan Dawn - Warm, inviting, reliable, non-touristy. Avoid clinical tech aesthetics and generic AI purple gradients.

spacing_and_layout.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto h-[100dvh] flex flex-col bg-[#FAFAF8] relative overflow-hidden

header.layout: flex justify-between items-center px-6 py-4 bg-transparent z-10

language_selector.layout: absolute left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 top-[45%] -translate-y-1/2 z-20 flex items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border border-[#E7E5E4] px-6 py-3 rounded-full shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(28,25,23,0.08)]
language_selector.swap_button: p-2 rounded-full bg-[#FAFAF8] text-[#D95D39] hover:bg-[#F4F1EA] transition-colors

translation_workspace.layout: flex flex-col flex-1 px-4 pb-24 gap-3 relative z-0

input_card.layout: flex-1 min-h-[40%] bg-[#FFFFFF] rounded-[28px] p-6 shadow-sm border border-[#E7E5E4]/50 flex flex-col
input_card.textarea: w-full h-full resize-none bg-transparent outline-none font-body text-3xl text-[#1C1917] placeholder:text-[#A8A29E] leading-tight

output_card.layout: flex-1 min-h-[40%] bg-[#F4F1EA] rounded-[28px] p-6 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between group
output_card.actions_row: flex justify-end gap-3 mt-4 opacity-100 transition-opacity

bottom_toolbar.layout: absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 p-6 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#FAFAF8] via-[#FAFAF8] to-transparent pt-12 flex justify-center gap-4 z-30
bottom_toolbar.primary_action: flex items-center justify-center w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-[#D95D39] text-white shadow-[0_12px_24px_rgba(217,93,57,0.25)] hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition-all
bottom_toolbar.secondary_action: flex items-center justify-center w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-white text-[#57534E] border border-[#E7E5E4] shadow-sm hover:text-[#1C1917] hover:border-[#A8A29E] active:scale-95 transition-all

icon_buttons.speak_button: p-3 rounded-full bg-white/60 hover:bg-white text-[#2B593F] transition-colors
icon_buttons.copy_button: p-3 rounded-full bg-white/60 hover:bg-white text-[#57534E] transition-colors
icon_buttons.clear_button: p-3 rounded-full bg-transparent hover:bg-[#F4F1EA] text-[#A8A29E] hover:text-[#D95D39] transition-colors

empty_state.layout: absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-8 text-center pointer-events-none z-0
empty_state.image_container: w-48 h-48 mb-6 rounded-full overflow-hidden opacity-90
empty_state.heading: font-heading text-2xl font-semibold text-[#1C1917] mb-2

empty_state_image.description: Minimalist photo of Himalayan mountains at dawn, to be used inside a soft organic circular mask or full background blend for the empty state.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first, single-screen experience. The main layout should not scroll; rather, the input and output areas should handle their own internal scrolling if text overflows.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn UI Cards or standard inputs. Use pure Tailwind to craft the 'cardless' input areas detailed in `components.translation_workspace` to maintain the frictionless, fluid feel.
Implement the 'Language Selector' as a floating pill (absolute positioned) that overlaps the boundary between the top (input) and bottom (output) cards. This creates tension and visual interest.
The camera and gallery actions should reside in a floating `bottom_toolbar` that sticks to the bottom. Prioritize Camera as the primary action (Terracotta color) and Gallery as secondary.
Do NOT use generic violet or purple. Stick strictly to the warm Terracotta (#D95D39) and Forest Green (#2B593F) over the Off-white base.
Always apply `data-testid` attributes to interactive elements for testing.
